title: Implement Dark Mode UI
description: Added CSS variables and a toggle in the user preferences table to switch the DOM to dark theme.

title: Webhook Retry Mechanism
description: Implemented exponential backoff retry logic for failed webhook deliveries up to 5 attempts.

title: Bulk CSV Export
description: Added a new endpoint to stream large datasets to CSV using pagination to prevent memory timeouts.

title: Multi-Factor Authentication
description: Integrated TOTP-based 2FA using authenticator apps with QR code generation and backup codes.

title: Custom Dashboard Widgets
description: Built drag-and-drop widget system with localStorage persistence and configurable data sources.

title: API Rate Limiting Dashboard
description: Created admin panel to view and adjust rate limits per API key with real-time usage metrics.

title: Scheduled Report Generation
description: Implemented cron-based job scheduler to generate and email PDF reports at configurable intervals.

title: Team Collaboration Spaces
description: Added shared workspaces with role-based permissions, activity feeds, and real-time notifications.

title: Advanced Search Filters
description: Built query parser supporting boolean operators, date ranges, and custom field filtering.

title: Data Import Wizard
description: Created multi-step import flow with validation, field mapping, and error handling for CSV/JSON files.

title: Mobile Push Notifications
description: Integrated Firebase Cloud Messaging for iOS and Android with topic-based subscription management.

title: Audit Log Viewer
description: Built searchable audit trail with user action tracking, timestamp filtering, and export capabilities.

title: User Profile Screen - New Fields
description: Added new fields to the User Profile screen. Fields and descriptions: | Field | Description | |-------|-------------| | Timezone | Select your local timezone for accurate scheduling | | Language Preference | Choose interface language from 12 supported options | | Notification Sound | Pick from 5 alert sounds or disable completely | | Two-Step Verification | Enable SMS or authenticator app backup codes | | Account Recovery Email | Add secondary email for password recovery |

title: Product Details Screen - New Fields
description: Enhanced Product Details screen with additional information fields. Fields and descriptions: | Field | Description | |-------|-------------| | SKU Number | Unique product identifier for inventory tracking | | Supplier Name | Name of the vendor providing this product | | Stock Status | Real-time availability: In Stock, Low Stock, Out of Stock | | Warranty Period | Duration of manufacturer warranty coverage | | Return Policy | Number of days allowed for returns and conditions |

title: Order Summary Screen - New Fields
description: Order Summary screen now displays comprehensive order details. Fields and descriptions: | Field | Description | |-------|-------------| | Order Tracking Number | Unique identifier to track shipment progress | | Estimated Delivery Date | Expected arrival date based on shipping method | | Payment Method | How the order was paid: Credit Card, PayPal, etc. | | Discount Applied | Any promotional codes or loyalty discounts used | | Shipping Address | Complete delivery address with contact information | | Order Notes | Special instructions or comments added by customer |

title: Dashboard Load Time Optimization
description: Implemented Redis caching for the main dashboard widget queries, reducing DB hits.

title: Global Search Indexing Upgrade
description: Upgraded Elasticsearch cluster and optimized the indexing pipeline for faster fuzzy matching.

title: Increase API Rate Limits
description: Bumped the standard tier rate limit from 100 req/min to 500 req/min in the API gateway config.

title: File Upload Size Limit Increase
description: Increased max upload size from 10MB to 100MB and added chunked upload support for large files.

title: Email Notification Batching
description: Implemented digest mode to batch notifications into daily/weekly summaries instead of individual emails.

title: Database Query Optimization
description: Added composite indexes and rewrote N+1 queries to reduce average response time by 60%.

title: User Interface Accessibility Improvements
description: Added ARIA labels, keyboard navigation, and screen reader support across all major components.

title: Session Management Enhancement
description: Extended session timeout from 30 minutes to 8 hours and added 'remember me' functionality.

title: Report Generation Speed
description: Parallelized PDF generation and added background processing to reduce wait time from 45s to 8s.

title: API Response Compression
description: Enabled gzip compression for all API responses, reducing payload size by average of 70%.

title: User Profile Customization
description: Added customizable themes, font size options, and layout preferences stored in user settings.

title: Login Page Null Pointer Exception
description: Fixed crash when email field was empty during OAuth redirect. Added null check before processing.

title: Dashboard Widget Data Mismatch
description: Corrected timezone conversion issue causing widget data to display previous day's metrics.

title: CSV Export Encoding Error
description: Fixed UTF-8 BOM missing in exported CSV files causing special characters to display incorrectly in Excel.

title: Search Results Pagination Broken
description: Resolved off-by-one error in pagination logic that skipped the first result on page 2+.

title: Password Reset Email Not Sending
description: Fixed SMTP configuration issue where password reset emails were queued but never delivered.

title: Mobile App Crash on Image Upload
description: Resolved memory leak in image compression library causing crashes on devices with <2GB RAM.

title: API Key Deletion Not Revoking Access
description: Fixed race condition where deleted API keys remained valid for up to 5 minutes due to cache delay.

title: Duplicate Notifications on Webhook Failure
description: Eliminated duplicate notification emails when webhook retry logic triggered multiple failure alerts.

title: Date Picker Showing Wrong Month
description: Fixed calendar component displaying January instead of December when navigating backwards.

title: User Avatar Upload Failing Silently
description: Added proper error handling and user feedback when avatar upload exceeds size limit or fails validation.

title: Report PDF Missing Charts
description: Fixed chart rendering library not initializing before PDF generation, causing blank chart areas.

title: Team Invitation Link Expiring Too Early
description: Corrected token expiration calculation that was using minutes instead of hours for 7-day invites.

title: Keyboard Shortcut Conflict in Editor
description: Resolved Ctrl+S conflict between browser save and in-app save, now properly intercepted.

title: Audit Log Showing Incorrect User
description: Fixed session handling bug where actions by admin users were logged under the previous user's ID.

title: Webhook Payload Missing Timestamp
description: Added ISO 8601 timestamp field to webhook payload that was accidentally removed in v2.3.0.

title: Browser Back Button Breaking Navigation
description: Fixed SPA router not properly handling browser history state, causing blank pages on back navigation.

title: Email Template Rendering HTML Tags
description: Corrected email template engine to properly escape HTML instead of displaying raw tags to users.

title: API Returning 500 on Invalid JSON
description: Added proper JSON parsing error handling to return 400 Bad Request instead of 500 Internal Server Error.

title: Notification Preferences Not Saving
description: Fixed localStorage quota exceeded error preventing notification settings from persisting across sessions.
